FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 230
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Vivian Davis Figures
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/19/2025
Senate Bill 230 as introduced would increase the financial obligations of the state by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of stolen federal benefits provided by the
Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) that would be reimbursed to Alabama
residents pursuant to the provisions of this bill. According to the Alabama Department of
Human Resources, during the first quarter of FY 2025, Alabama recipients were reimbursed $12
million in federal SNAP benefits by the federal government.
